_comment: A faithful npm packument for a package literally NAMED 1.2.3 that publishes only 0.0.1. An earlier version of this fixture named it v1.2.3, which only bites when a leading-v strip exists -- it could not detect the unscoped-reader hole it was written to guard, and an adversarial pass proved the suite stayed green under exactly that mutant. Bare, it detects both.
